notes.title: New addition of modular girl characters
notes.content:
[b]A new TechWear girl character has been added. [/b]
Now, you can choose between a male soldier character and a TechWear girl. Choose your girl's face, hair, costumes, and more as you wish and start.

- Added a new modular character of the girl
- Added Y axis switching option
- Adjusted Field of view
